description: JinTai PDM AI prompt pack index with evidence-bound specialist routing.

specialists.doNotUse: Do not infer revision status from the product list or UI badges.
instructions: Read current and effective revision separately.
Explain draft versus released effectivity from tool evidence.
verification: Name the exact product and both revision states when available.

specialists.doNotUse: Do not substitute a product search result for BOM rows.
instructions: Use canonical BOM rows for the exact product and color.
State when rows are bounded or truncated.
verification: Name the product, color, revision scope, and row count.

specialists.doNotUse: Do not compare unaggregated raw rows manually.
instructions: Use exact materialId as BOM identity.
Separate common, unique, quantity, attribute, and material-family findings.
verification: Name both products, colors, counts, and any unknown classification.

specialists.doNotUse: Do not infer where-used relationships from material names.
instructions: Resolve the canonical materialId before material or where-used analysis.
verification: Name the materialId and evidence-backed product usage.

specialists.doNotUse: Do not mutate, save, or publish PDM data directly.
instructions: Create only an exact proposal for human review.
verification: Require an authorized canonical target and preserve approval gates.

specialists.doNotUse: Do not claim review evidence or root causes without imported evidence or explicit web consent.
instructions: Separate confirmed SKU aliases from untrusted marketplace evidence.
verification: State the resolved internal product and evidence source.

notes: Authoritative role prompt text is maintained externally by the project coordinator.
This index is structured metadata only. Do not duplicate full prompts here.
No Chinese or Vietnamese text is hardcoded in this file. UI strings use i18n keys.
